proposed_widenings.name: grant_mastery_access
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature grants the character the ability to use the mastery property of N chosen weapon kinds. The existing grant_proficiency atom covers weapon category proficiency (attack/damage eligibility), not mastery-property eligibility. Mastery properties are already modeled as separate MasteryRecord units; this atom would link a character to the ability to use those records for chosen weapon kinds. No existing EffectAtom variant covers 'you may use the mastery property of weapons of kind X'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of Simple or Martial Melee weapons of your choice, such as Greataxes and Handaxes.

proposed_widenings.name: rest_reconfigurable_choice on PassiveMechanics or grant_mastery_access
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature allows replacing one chosen weapon kind after each Long Rest ('practice weapon drills and change one of those weapon choices'). This is a rest-triggered partial rebuild of a build-time choice — not modeled by any existing reset_cadence or activation pattern. The current surface has rest-triggered resource refills but no mechanism for rest-triggered reassignment of a passive grant parameter.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can practice weapon drills and change one of those weapon choices.

proposed_widenings.name: level-scaled count on grant_mastery_access
proposed_widenings.justification: The number of weapon kinds grows at certain Barbarian levels per the Barbarian Features table. ThresholdTiers<number> exists in the surface and could express the scaling count, but only if the grant_mastery_access atom itself existed to carry it.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you reach certain Barbarian levels, you gain the ability to use the mastery properties of more kinds of weapons, as shown in the Weapon Mastery column of the Barbarian Features table.

notes: The passive family (family='passive') is structurally correct for this feature — it is always-on while the character has the feature. The blocker is entirely at the atom level: no EffectAtom variant expresses 'you may use the mastery property of a chosen weapon kind'. The rest-reconfigurable choice is a secondary gap. Both gaps are independent of v4 taxonomy — the v4 graph has no atom analogous to grant_mastery_access.
